title: Dīghalaṭṭhi
text: 1. Evaṃ me sutam ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane Kalandakanivāpe || 2. Atha kho Dīghalaṭṭhi devaputto abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇo kevalakappaṃ Veḷuvanam obhāsetvā yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antam aṭṭāsi || Ekam antaṃ ṭhito kho Dīghalaṭṭhi devaputto Bhagavato santike imaṃ gātham abhāsi || || 3. Bhikkhu siyā jhāyī vimuttacitto || ākaṅkhe ca hadayassānupattiṃ || lokassa ñatvā udayabbayaṃ ca || sucetaso asito tadānisaṃso ti || ||
